answers.core: This affects GDScript's built-in static typing and editor autocompletion, which are handled by GDScriptAnalyzer in the engine core and cannot be overridden by addons or editor plugins.
answers.workaround:
Manually casting results (e.g. using `as Array[User]`) is not a practical workaround, as this would need to be repeated across every container operation throughout the project.

More fundamentally, this issue originates from GDScriptAnalyzer's type inference. Since it affects editor-time static analysis, the only proper solution is to address it in the engine itself.

title: GDScript: Typed containers lose element types in built-in methods
